name: The Laying On Hands
overview: The laying on of hands in Scripture serves as a tangible means by which God imparts wisdom, healing, and the Holy Spirit. From Moses laying hands on Joshua to empower him with wisdom (Deuteronomy 34:9), to Jesus healing the sick by laying hands on them (Mark 6:5; Luke 4:40), this practice signifies divine empowerment and blessing. The early church continued this tradition, laying hands on individuals to appoint leaders (Acts 6:6) and to bestow the Holy Spirit (Acts 8:17; Acts 9:17), demonstrating its vital role in spiritual commissioning and ministry.
